source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Interior door heights (corridor doors) assumed 2.1m, no elevation evidence available for interior partitions.
East window height assumed equal to measured north/south 1F window family (no direct East elevation measurement performed in this pass).

South/East window heights (W_S1-3, W_East) assumed equal to the North_view.png-measured 1F window family (head 2.653m, sill 1.023m above ground); not independently pixel-measured on South_view.png/East_view.png in this pass. North-facing windows W_N1-3 now use directly measured North_view.png pixel evidence via claim_0001.
Ground-floor exterior doors D_West and D_South now use directly measured elevation pixel evidence (claims 0003/0004: heads at 2.135m and 2.132m respectively) instead of the initial assumed values.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
Interior 2F door heights assumed 2.1m clear (z 3.0-5.1m), no elevation evidence for interior partitions.
South/East/West 2F window heights assumed equal to the North_view-measured 2F window family (sill 4.03m, head 5.86m); not independently pixel-measured on those elevations in this pass.
No exterior doors exist on F2 per plan and elevation evidence (West_view/East_view show only windows on F2); vertical circulation between F1 and F2 is not shown in supplied inputs and is not modeled.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.
